pages.text: $(l)The classic early setup:$() Slime Boots + Slimesling + Hang Glider.$(li)$(l)Infinite flight:$() boots with $(l)Multi-Jump III$() let you jump in mid-air while gliding. Multi-jump resets on a timer, not when you land, so you can climb forever.

Hold Shift to glide faster.$(li)$(l)Cyclic Player Launcher$() beats the slimesling, especially combined with the glider. It accelerates exponentially with slime boots, so be careful.$(li)Keep the slimesling even after you can fly. Launching first, then flying, keeps the momentum.

$(li)$(l)Bessie$() (TARDIS mod): cheap, fast, crosses water, takes no fall damage.$(li)$(l)Floo Network$() (Random Things): the earliest teleporting.$(li)$(l)Spectral Key$() (Random Things): hold right-click to enter a private 14x2x14 room. Right-clicking the center 4 blocks with Ectoplasm makes it 254 tall.

Use it as an escape, a loot room or a teleport hub.$(li)A Cyclic chorus-fruit-like food gives creative flight; eat several to stack the duration.$(li)The $(l)Autojump$() control acts as step assist in this pack.
